{{Quote|This is the Atoan system, in the so-called Ghost Nebula. Largely unexplored, but inhabited.|[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Darth Vader and the Lost Command 1">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 1|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Atoan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]],<ref name="DV&tLC" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]], the [[Atoan]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and some other settled worlds.<ref name="DV&tLC" />

==History==
A [[Atoan insurgency|major campaign]] for the Imperials took place in the system shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] were sent to investigate the disappearance of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garoche Tarkin]]. In actuality, he had defected to [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]], [[High Priest/Legends|High Priestess]] of Atoa, one of the rulers of the system. Saro and Tarkin were eventually killed by Vader.<ref name="DV&tLC" />
